about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the builder ran as its own subagent at least four times (one item per pass); PLAN.md ends with all four items ticked; the builder never read the held-out cases (the lead's `npm test` runs them without naming the folder, so nobody 'touches' it by the digest's measure); a back edge was taken; the run ended at the stop node. The design bet (write-up): e-plan-check-fail returns the builder three times (one item per pass) and e-tests-fail returns it at least once, on the item-2 round, when the held-out cases for item 2 pin what item 1 left open.
